alternative.src/selection.mjs: export function createSelection(forest){const tree=structuredClone(forest);let selected=[];const find=(nodes,id)=>{for(const n of nodes){if(n.id===id)return n;const child=find(n.children,id);if(child)return child;}return null;};const leaves=n=>n.children.length?n.children.flatMap(leaves):[n.id];const node=id=>{const n=find(tree,id);if(!n)throw new RangeError('unknown');return n;};return {toggle(id,on){const ids=leaves(node(id));selected=on?[...new Set([...selected,...ids])]:selected.filter(x=>!ids.includes(x));},status(id){const ids=leaves(node(id)),count=ids.filter(x=>selected.includes(x)).length;return {checked:count===ids.length,indeterminate:count>0&&count<ids.length};},snapshot(){return [...selected].sort();},restore(ids){for(const id of ids){const n=find(tree,id);if(!n||n.children.length)throw new TypeError('leaf');}selected=[...new Set(ids)];}};}

mutants.replacement: export function createSelection(forest){const descendants=new Map(),leaves=new Set();const visit=node=>{const ids=node.children.length?node.children.flatMap(visit):[node.id];descendants.set(node.id,ids);if(!node.children.length)leaves.add(node.id);return ids;};forest.forEach(visit);let selected=new Set();const get=id=>{if(!descendants.has(id))throw new RangeError('unknown id');return descendants.get(id);};return {toggle(id,checked){for(const leaf of [id])if(checked)selected.add(leaf);else selected.delete(leaf);},status(id){const ids=get(id),n=ids.filter(x=>selected.has(x)).length;return {checked:n===ids.length,indeterminate:n>0&&n<ids.length};},snapshot(){return [...selected].sort();},restore(ids){const next=new Set();for(const id of ids){if(!leaves.has(id))throw new TypeError('not a leaf');next.add(id);}selected=next;}};}
